ops.title: Compare batch rows against the raw database snapshot
ops.description:
Owner: drive-lock coordinator (caller).
Next executable step: obtain raw held records from the same load snapshot, as loaded_rows() does, or use a matching revision for optimistic validation; do not compare shaped records to raw stored records.
Evidence: cfc47e545 plugins/long-running/lib/drive/state.py:5044 passes row_of(now,row) from shaped load() as held. rows_saved() compares held with raw JSON decoded from the database (:4760-4764). A PR whose stored row lacks reviews_required gets that field from shaped() (:1238), so every batch changing that PR falsely races all five times with no concurrent writer. New-drive terminal/binder defaults can have the same mismatch. The previous whole save persisted shaped defaults without this refusal.
Static review only; no tests run.

ops.text: A batch can modify an older PR row missing a shaped default with no concurrent writer and no false Raced refusal.
A batch changing a newly defaulted top-level field succeeds while genuine concurrent row changes still trigger retry/refusal.
